settings.eyebrow: Voltage Live · Independent Music Venue · Downtown District
settings.headline:
Where the city
comes to listen.
settings.copy: Voltage Live is the independent venue where rising acts, late-night sets, and a crowd that actually listens meet under one roof — 400 seats, zero bad sightlines, and sound that hits you in the chest.

trust_list.text: House-tuned PA and a stage that touring acts love
Full bar, kitchen, and late-night kitchen till close
Named one of the city's best small venues three years running

settings.title: A room built
settings.intro: We measure a good night by the same things you do: great sound, a full room, and a crowd that stays till the last song.

stats.label: Seats, every one with a clear view of the stage
Years as an independent, locally owned venue

settings.title: Drinks and plates
settings.intro: A proper bar and a kitchen that stays open late. Local taps, a tight cocktail list, and bar food that's actually good — not just 'venue food'.

items.name: Voltage IPA
items.description: Local hazy IPA, citrus-forward, on tap from a neighborhood brewery.

items.name: Smoked Old Fashioned
items.description: Bourbon, smoked maple, bitters, orange oil. Our signature late-night pour.

items.name: Loaded Nacho Board
items.description: House chips, three-cheese sauce, jalapeño, crema, pickled onion. Feeds two.

items.name: Voltage Burger
items.description: Half-pound patty, cheddar, house sauce, brioche bun, fries.

items.name: Late-Night Poutine
items.description: Crispy fries, gravy, cheese curds, scallion. Served till close.

items.name: Zero-Proof Spritz
items.description: Seedlip, grapefruit, rosemary, soda. For the designated drivers.

settings.title: Friday Night Headliner
settings.expired_text: That show's wrapped — check the calendar for what's coming next at Voltage Live.

settings.title: Built for the
settings.intro: From the moment you walk in to the last encore, every detail is tuned for one thing: a night of live music you'll actually remember.

features.title: Sound that lands
features.text: A house-tuned PA and a room designed for acoustics, not capacity. Every seat hears the mix the way the artist intended.

features.title: No bad seats
features.text: A gently raked floor and sightlines from every angle. Whether you're at the rail or the back bar, you see the stage.

features.title: A stage artists love
features.text: A proper backline, a real green room, and a crew that treats touring acts like people. That's why they come back.

features.title: Late-night kitchen
features.text: The kitchen runs till close, so the show doesn't end when your stomach starts talking. Real food, not just pretzels.

features.title: Local at heart
features.text: Independently owned for 12 years. We book local openers, pour local beer, and give back to the scene that built us.

features.title: Easy in, easy out
features.text: Fast entry, a coat check that works, and a bar that doesn't make you miss the opener. We've thought about the details.

settings.title: What the crowd
settings.intro: From first-time ticket buyers to touring bands, here's what people say about a night at Voltage.

reviews.quote: I've seen bands here that I'd have to fly to another city to catch anywhere else. The sound is unreal for a room this size, and the staff actually care about the music.
reviews.author: Maya R.

reviews.quote: We've played bigger rooms, but Voltage is the one we look forward to. The crew is professional, the green room is real, and the crowd listens. That's rare.
reviews.author: Theo Grant

reviews.quote: Came for a show, stayed for the poutine and the vibe. It's the rare venue that feels like a neighborhood spot and a proper music room at the same time.
reviews.author: Priya S.

settings.title: Come see a show,
settings.intro: Grab tickets for an upcoming night, or reach out about booking your band, hosting a private event, or renting the room. We'll get back to you fast.
settings.location: 214 Neon Row, Downtown District · Doors at 7pm on show nights
